plan.overview: A high-energy 3-day exploration designed for a group of friends, balancing hyper-modern neon districts, historic shrines, legendary ramen and street food alleys, and scenic viewpoints across Tokyo's most vibrant neighborhoods.
plan.weatherSummary: Mild and pleasant, around 18°C–23°C. Comfortable walking shoes and light layering with an umbrella are recommended.

currencyAndCostEstimate.breakdown: Daily food: ~$40–60, Transit: ~$12, Attractions & Activities: ~$35, Souvenirs & Misc: ~$30

transportationGuide.overview: Tokyo boasts the world's most efficient public rail and subway network. Trains run with near-zero delays until midnight.
transportationGuide.recommendedPasses: Suica or Pasmo digital card (added to Apple/Google Wallet) or Tokyo Subway 72-hour Tourist Ticket (¥1,500).
transportationGuide.metroBusTips: Look for station numbers on Tokyo Metro and Toei lines (e.g., G05 for Ginza Line). Tap in and out at turnstiles.
transportationGuide.airportTransfer: Narita Express (N'EX) or Skyliner into Tokyo/Ueno; Keikyu Line from Haneda directly into central Tokyo.
transportationGuide.rideSharing: JapanTaxi or GO Taxi app. Taxis are clean and safe; automatic doors open for you.

packingAndPrepTips: Pocket Wi-Fi or eSIM for seamless navigation through multi-level stations.
Slip-on walking shoes (easy removal at temples and traditional tatami eateries).
Coin pouch for vending machines and coin lockers.
Small power bank to keep smartphones charged for maps and translation apps.

days.title: Day 1: Historic Asakusa, Akihabara Tech & Shinjuku Neon
days.summary: Step back into Edo-era traditions at Senso-ji temple, browse electronic wonders in Akihabara, and finish with sizzling yakitori in Omoide Yokocho.

schedule.title: Traditional Breakfast at Asakusa Misojyu
schedule.description: Warm up with artisanal, hearty miso soup sets made with organic vegetables and hand-rolled onigiri (rice balls).
schedule.tips: Arrive right at opening to avoid queues; try the braised pork belly miso broth.

schedule.title: Explore Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise-dori
schedule.description: Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, passing through the grand Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate) and sampling fresh ningyo-yaki treats.
schedule.tips: Wave fragrant incense smoke toward you at the giant bronze urn for good luck.

schedule.title: Tsukuba Express to Akihabara
schedule.description: Hop on the rapid train connecting Asakusa directly to electric town Akihabara in just two quick stops.
schedule.tips: Use IC card (Suica/Pasmo) for instant tap-and-go entry.

schedule.title: Akihabara Tech & Multi-Floor Arcade Challenge
schedule.description: Dive into retro gaming shrines like Super Potato and test group reflexes with Taiko no Tatsujin drum games at GiGO.
schedule.tips: Bring 100-yen coins for arcade machines and UFO crane games.

schedule.title: Lunch at Kyushu Jangara Ramen Akihabara
schedule.description: Beloved ramen counter serving rich Tonkotsu pork broth topped with melt-in-your-mouth Kakuni pork belly and marinated eggs.

schedule.title: JR Yamanote Line to Shinjuku
schedule.description: Ride Tokyo's famous green circular line westward across the metropolis toward bustling Shinjuku.

schedule.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observation Deck
schedule.description: Soar up to the 45th floor panoramic observatory for breathtaking views across the Tokyo skyline, with Mount Fuji visible on clear days.
schedule.tips: Arrive 30 minutes before sunset to watch the neon lights switch on across the city.

schedule.title: Dinner & Drinks at Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane)
schedule.description: Atmospheric lantern-lit alleyway packed with intimate yakitori stalls grilling skewers over binchotan charcoal.
schedule.tips: Great for sharing skewers and local draft beers or highballs with friends.
